Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 50c4a681d0e3bee30e415a1ecc663ff5eab158f8` or `Fix review: blocked 50c4a681d0e3bee30e415a1ecc663ff5eab158f8 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: a40c3488651515a962e45d98fbdbf21c`; put the evidence in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `50c4a681d0e3bee30e415a1ecc663ff5eab158f8` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2578 50c4a681d0e3bee30e415a1ecc663ff5eab158f8") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2578-a40c3488`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.
